description:
A New Standard for Image Viewers

BandiView is the succeeding image viewer to Honeyview, that inherits everything cool of its predecessor and also gets improved even further. Fast and easy to view images in a variety of formats, from the most common ones to the most professional ones.
- Increased the number of Photo Folders from 2 to 4
- Improved ICC profile processing settings and added support for switching modes with a keyboard shortcut
- Added a brief pause at the Fit in Window zoom level when zooming in or out
- Improved image loading performance in Smart Double page mode
- Added support for converting all pages of TIFF files to separate files
- Added support for displaying EXIF information in TIFF files
- Improved support, security, and stability for various image formats
- Improved program stability
- Other modifications
